# HealthDock (gethealthdock.com)

> Free, 100% browser-local Apple Health export tools (zero upload, zero servers). Stream-parse Apple Health `export.zip` or `export.xml` files (500MB–2GB+) directly in your browser to generate an AI-ready `context.md` for ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, NotebookLM, Grok, Perplexity, DeepSeek & local Ollama—or export Obsidian YAML Markdown, clean CSV/JSON, and local Sleep & HRV charts.

## Free Local AI & Export Tools

- [HealthDock — Universal Apple Health Converter (AI Context & CSV)](https://gethealthdock.com/en/): Instant browser-local converter turning `export.zip` or `export.xml` into `context.md` (7d/30d/90d baselines, ≥2 SD unusual days, yearly averages, 8-week training load) or CSV/JSON.
- [Apple Health to ChatGPT Converter](https://gethealthdock.com/en/tools/apple-health-to-chatgpt/): Stream-parse huge Apple Health exports locally into a ~2KB `context.md` plus a Python-ready Daily CSV for ChatGPT Data Analysis charts, ChatGPT Projects, and Custom GPTs.
- [Apple Health to Claude (`context.md` Generator)](https://gethealthdock.com/en/tools/apple-health-to-claude/): Dedicated streaming converter with ready-to-paste Claude health review prompts. Works worldwide (outside the US) and with Claude Web, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and Cursor.
- [Apple Health to Google Gemini & NotebookLM Converter](https://gethealthdock.com/en/tools/apple-health-to-gemini/): Generates `context.md`, a NotebookLM-compatible `.txt` source, and Multi-Year Daily JSON built for Gemini's 1M+ token context window and Gemini Gems.
- [Apple Health to Grok Converter](https://gethealthdock.com/en/tools/apple-health-to-grok/): Generates a compact ~2KB `context.md` and Daily CSV tailored for Grok Think mode, DeepSearch norm benchmarking, and Private Chat on grok.com and X.
- [Apple Health to Perplexity Converter](https://gethealthdock.com/en/tools/apple-health-to-perplexity/): Generates `context.md` for Perplexity Spaces with Academic-source prompts for peer-reviewed VO2max, HRV, and sleep norm citations.
- [Apple Health to DeepSeek R1 & Local Ollama](https://gethealthdock.com/en/tools/apple-health-to-deepseek/): Generates a ~600-token `context.md` plus ready-to-run local `ollama run deepseek-r1` CLI commands for 100% air-gapped health AI on Mac.
- [Apple Health to Obsidian Markdown & YAML](https://gethealthdock.com/en/tools/apple-health-to-obsidian/): Exports Obsidian Properties YAML frontmatter for Daily Notes, a Health MOC note, a wiki-linked 90-day log table, and ready-to-paste Dataview queries.
- [Apple Health Sleep & HRV Analyzer](https://gethealthdock.com/en/tools/apple-health-hrv-sleep-analyzer/): 100% browser-local dashboard charting 30 nights of Total/Deep/REM sleep and HRV (SDNN) against your 90-day personal baseline band with ≥2 SD unusual night detection.
- [Fix Large Apple Health `export.xml` (500MB–2GB+)](https://gethealthdock.com/en/tools/apple-health-export-xml-too-large/): Stream huge exports that crash Excel or Chrome in 4MB slices, slice by year, and shrink file size by 99.9% into Excel-ready CSV.
- [Apple Health XML to CSV & JSON Converter](https://gethealthdock.com/en/tools/xml-to-csv/): Filter by custom date range and 15 health metrics to export Daily Summary CSV, Workouts CSV, or Daily Summary JSON for Excel, Numbers, Python, or DuckDB.

## Key Technical Properties

- **Privacy**: 100% client-side JavaScript Web Worker. Zero server uploads, zero accounts, zero analytics.
- **Large File Support**: Streams `export.xml` in 4MB slices and decompresses `export.zip` via native browser `DecompressionStream('deflate-raw')` without loading the XML DOM into RAM.
- **Data Cleaning**: Merges overlapping sleep intervals (18:00–12:00 night windows), prevents Apple Watch + iPhone cumulative step double-counting, converts units (`lb` → `kg`, `kJ` → `kcal`, fractional `SpO2` → `%`), and filters anomalous future/zero-duration sleep records.
